claim_text: Potassium supplements and potassium-containing salt substitutes can cause hyperkalemia in susceptible people, particularly with kidney impairment or medicines that reduce potassium excretion.
health_goal_or_outcome: Identify safety constraints and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.

population.other_context: People taking medicines that affect potassium balance.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation, concentration and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Potassium fact sheet describes hyperkalemia risk and relevant medicines.
limitations: No dose; medication and renal review required.
Exact source passages, product-specific labeling and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
